title: AGF Launch Roadmap Section
description: Phased go-to-market sequencing for AGF's inaugural product line, including PR levers, venue pilots, and Year-1 volume targets.

section_label.description: Short label shown in the section eyebrow after the number (e.g. 'The Consolidation').

intro_text.description: Markdown-formatted overview of the launch sequencing logic.

phases.description: Ordered launch phases with associated products, TTM, and rationale.

ttm.description: Time-to-market range for this phase (e.g., '4-6 months').

rationale.description: Markdown-formatted reasoning for why this phase ships in this order.

milestones.description: Key milestones or gates within this phase.

pr_stunts.description: Public-relations or marketing levers timed to the launch sequence.

name.description: Short identifier for the stunt (e.g., 'Symphony Review-Tier Anchor').

description.description: Markdown-formatted description of the stunt and its mechanic.

timing.description: When relative to the launch this stunt fires.

appendix.description: markdown — supporting notes for the appendix

venue_pilots.description: Venue-pilot strategy for the launch period.

criteria.description: Markdown-formatted selection criteria for pilot markets.

anchor_reference.description: Reference comp (e.g., Wasted Real-Estate vs Focal flagship benchmark).

notes.description: Markdown-formatted notes on how the target compounds over Y1.

_viz_config.description: Gantt visualization configuration (editable via Edit UI).
